label: preparing
what: A coordinated residents' gathering with substantial bread refreshments and a private community presentation at eighteen sharp in the town hall. The gathering itself was disclosed and approved, but presentation details and coordinated provisioning were not told to me directly. It may celebrate my forty years of service, though that remains a guess. Innkeeper organizes and offers personal funding; baker and freight appear to handle bread provisioning, and builder supplies materials and relays escort arrangements. Secretary knowingly assists scheduling and escort coordination, without clear evidence of knowing the private presentation's contents.
